screen.stormtree.title: Lightning Skill Tree
screen.stormtree.click_select: Click: select, then click a slot below (or press 1-4)
screen.stormtree.hint: Left click: unlock / select  •  Right click slot: clear  •  Hover + 1-4: assign
item.stormtree.storm_tome.tip1: Right click: open the skill tree
item.stormtree.storm_tome.tip2: Carried in hotbar or offhand: skill energy costs -20%
skill.stormtree.thunder_strike.desc: Calls lightning down where you aim: 8 damage in 2.5 blocks, ignites and slows.
skill.stormtree.static_core.desc: Passive: +50 max energy, 75% faster regeneration. Melee hits have a 30% chance to shock (+3 damage, slow). Immune to real lightning, which refills your energy.
skill.stormtree.lightning_bolt.desc: Fires a very fast piercing bolt: 7 damage and slow to up to 3 targets.
skill.stormtree.spark_burst.desc: Discharges around you: 6 damage and knockback to enemies within 6 blocks.
skill.stormtree.storm_dome.desc: 8 second energy shield: -60% damage taken, incoming projectiles are reflected, melee attackers get shocked and pushed.
skill.stormtree.static_ring.desc: 10 seconds of an orbiting lightning ring: 3 damage every half second to up to 4 enemies within 4.5 blocks.
skill.stormtree.thunderstorm.desc: Rains 10 lightning strikes on the target area over 3 seconds, enemies first (7 damage each).
skill.stormtree.storm_avatar.desc: Become the storm for 15s: Speed II, Strength I, Haste II, Jump; double energy regen, faster cooldowns; melee hits arc to 2 nearby enemies for 4.
skill.stormtree.shock_grasp.desc: Pulls the target in front of you and pins it for 2.5 seconds; ~16 damage total. Bosses are slowed instead of pulled.
skill.stormtree.ball_lightning.desc: Slow drifting orb that zaps 2 nearby enemies on its way (4) and detonates for 10 on impact or expiry.
skill.stormtree.chain_lightning.desc: Deals 10 to the target and jumps 7 times to nearby enemies (-15% per jump).
skill.stormtree.thunder_nova.desc: Rise and gather power, then up to 16 damage, stun, knockback and lightning on enemies within 12 blocks.
skill.stormtree.lightning_spear.desc: After a short charge, fires a 64 block piercing beam: 20 damage and burning to everything in the line.
skill.stormtree.storm_reaper.desc: Passive: your lightning executes non-boss targets that drop below 20% health. Every lightning kill restores 10 energy and cuts cooldowns by 1s.
